# EMS Stuff

> > Medical supply resource for EMS providers and agencies across the Northeast, specializing in New York State regulations and equipment requirements.

EMS Stuff is operated by Medical Warehouse, serving emergency medical services organizations throughout New York, Connecticut, and the broader Northeast region. The site provides regulatory guidance, equipment resources, and supplier information tailored to EMS agencies, ambulance services, and first responders.

## Key Topics

- New York State EMS regulations
- Part 800 compliance
- REMSCO (Regional EMS Councils)
- Hudson Valley NY REMSCO
- Nassau County NY REMSCO
- Suffolk County NY REMSCO
- Westchester County NY REMSCO
- Ambulance equipment requirements
- EMS certification levels
- Tax exemptions for EMS organizations
- Medical supply brands
- Northeast EMS (CT, MA, ME, NH, RI, VT, PA)
- Inspection forms and checklists
- Medical Warehouse

## EMS Regulations & Compliance

- [EMS Resources](https://www.emsstuff.com/ems-resources/): NY State EMS regulations, Part 800, REMSCO links & equipment lists

## Supplier Information

- [Medical Warehouse Brands](https://www.emsstuff.com/brands/): Directory of medical supply brands: 3M, ADC, AMBU, Allied Medical
- [Meet the Medical Warehouse Team!](https://www.emsstuff.com/about-us/): Medical Warehouse team bios: Mark & Debbie Hertzberg, company history

## Account & Tax Information

- [Tax Exemptions and Sales Tax](https://www.emsstuff.com/tax-exemptions-and-sales-tax/): Tax exemption info for NY & CT organizations, resale certificates
